scope_summary: Atomic precheck for one Workflow MVP foundation slice only. Verify artifact identity, bounded scope, affected file cluster, risk level, and evidence gate before janus-executioner starts. No proactive offer flow, no routine runner, no routines UI, no Memory Session-Search, and no product transport/provider expansion.
acceptance_focus: target task identity is unique and consistent
scope stays bounded to Routine-Store, Schema, Detector, and Step-Trace extraction only
required evidence is concrete and executable
no architecture drift or provider fallback is introduced
evidence_focus: pytest coverage for routine store CRUD, registry validation, and fingerprint dedup
pytest coverage for step ordering, failed-step filtering, and offer-candidate detection
py_compile coverage for new workflow modules
scoped diff hygiene on the bound workflow task chain
